content: OpenAI Codex CLI non-interactive: 'codex exec <prompt>' runs headless, streams progress to stderr, writes final agent message to stdout. --json emits JSONL events; --output-schema <file> constrains the final message to a JSON Schema; --sandbox controls filesystem/network safety (no prompting in exec mode); 'codex exec resume --last' or 'codex exec resume <SESSION_ID>' continues a prior session. This mirrors Claude Code's 'claude -p --output-format stream-json --resume <id>' closely enough that a common agentic-CLI adapter interface (run/resume, JSONL event stream, structured verdict via schema) is viable.
